name: type-and-run
description: Runs the backend and the React game together. Flutter: see flutter_game/README.md

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix react_game install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,react -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix react_game run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix react_game test
